channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: As a crippling outage causes chaos in Japan, the fax gains favor
item.description: While Microsoft 365 struggles to fix a global outage, some have praised the fax machine as a reliable tool in the face of online disruptions.

item.title: Business booming for cybersecurity companies in Japan
item.description: With the increase in the number of cyberattacks, phones are ringing off the hook as customers seek everything from recovery to testing.

item.title: “Yankii” fashion for coming-of-age ceremony showcased in London
item.description: The exhibition displays both the yankii fashion culture centered on standing out from the crowd and the originality and diversity seen in Kitakyushu.

item.title: Sheep-shearing and puffer fish among items in Japan’s New Year lucky bags
item.description: Stores are also offering sheep-themed items, as 2027 is the Year of the Sheep in the 12-year Chinese zodiac cycle.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
